API Reference

sagittal_brain package

sagittal_brain.run_averages(file_input='brain_sample.csv', file_output='brain_average.csv')[source]

Calculates the average through the coronal planes The input file should has as many columns as coronal planes The rows are intersections of the sagittal/horizontal planes

The result is the average for each sagittal/horizontal plane (rows)
